quest.title: The Attack of the... Purple Tepetlisaurus?
quest.description: A merchant caravan seems to have met with some mishap on the path to the volcano...

dialogues.speaker: Tizlo
dialogues.text: Hey! You, yeah, I'm talking to you! It's dangerous out there, get inside, quick!

dialogues.speaker: Tizlo
dialogues.text: Haven't you seen the mess along the way? There's been a volcanic eruption, and there are monsters blocking the road. You shouldn't go any further.

dialogues.speaker: Tizlo
dialogues.text: Listen to me. Stay here for a bit and wait. In a while, you can head out with the rest of our caravan. That way, we can watch each other's backs. Otherwise, it's way too dangerous to go alone.

response.speaker: Tizlo
response.text: Yeah, a whole pack of purple Tepetlisaurs! They've clearly been corrupted by the Abyss! Insanely destructive. Honestly, I've never seen any of their kind this terrifying before!

response.speaker: Tizlo
response.text: Let me tell you, those things casually swung their tails and completely wrecked our carts. They're even stronger than Tatankasaurs — definitely not the kind of opponents just anyone can handle.

response.speaker: Tizlo
response.text: I'm serious — don't get all hot-headed and try to fight them. If you see them, just steer clear, alright?

response.speaker: Tizlo
response.text: You... *sigh*... alright, just be careful out there...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Share Phlogiston.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It blinks, as if to thank you.)

dialogues.speaker: Zashari
dialogues.text: *panting*

response.speaker: Zashari
response.text: I—I'm okay, just got a bit flustered from running earlier. Need a moment to catch my breath...

response.speaker: Zashari
response.text: Um, th—thanks for your concern...

dialogues.speaker: Masose
dialogues.text: Hey, you over there! St—Stop! This stuff is ours! Hands off! I'm warning you...! I—I could totally qualify for the Night Warden Wars!

dialogues.speaker: Masose
dialogues.text: You try taking our things, and I'll... I'll show you what for!

dialogues.speaker: Itsaho
dialogues.text: *sigh*... What's going on today? First a volcanic eruption, then a purple Tepetlisaurus... and now a bunch of bandits? What rotten luck...

dialogues.speaker: Itsaho
dialogues.text: #Masose, {M#he}{F#she} looks pretty tough. I don't think we can take {M#him}{F#her}. Besides, we're just here to watch the competition, not get involved...

dialogues.speaker: Masose
dialogues.text: H—How can you say that, Itsaho? This is OUR stuff! And anyway, it's two against one here. We might actually stand a chance!

dialogues.speaker: Itsaho
dialogues.text: Where are you getting that "two" from? If anyone's getting beaten up, it's just you. Don't drag me into this...

dialogues.speaker: Itsaho
dialogues.text: #Uh, hey, {M#sir}{F#ma'am}, we don't want the stuff anymore. If you want it, just take it. Just don't hurt us, okay?

choices.text: This has to be a misunderstanding...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've got it all wrong! We're actually helpful adventurers, not some random villains!

response.speaker: Masose
response.text: And why should I believe yo— Ow! The heck did you hit me for, Itsaho!?

response.speaker: Itsaho
response.text: If they were up to no good, they'd have already beaten you up. Why would they even waste time talking to us?

response.speaker: Itsaho
response.text: To be honest with you both, our caravan got scattered not long ago. If it's not too much trouble, could you help us pass a message to our boss? Just let her know we're waiting for her here — we'd really appreciate it.

response.speaker: Itsaho
response.text: You can take the things in the box — consider them our token of thanks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's easy enough. Leave it to us!

choices.text: Hmm, quite the bright spark, aren't you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Don't make it sound like we're the bad guys here!

dialogues.speaker: Cuchihua
dialogues.text: What am I gonna do... What am I gonna do? The boss is definitely gonna beat me up when I get back...

response.speaker: Cuchihua
response.text: *sigh* It's a long story... Our caravan was moving along just fine when the volcano erupted out of nowhere. Then, these massive purple Tepetlisaurs burst out of the ground...

response.speaker: Cuchihua
response.text: I wasn't paying attention, and my saurian partner got spooked and carried me far from the group. By the time I got us turned back around, the path was completely blocked, and now I can't get back to the others...

response.speaker: Cuchihua
response.text: I don't even know how everyone else is doing... and I ditched the group without permission... The boss is gonna kill me. I'm done. This is it. I'm dead.

choices.text: If it were me, I'd just run...

response.speaker: Cuchihua
response.text: Run? No, no, no, that's impossible. The boss is like the Night Kingdom — everywhere, all the time. She'll hunt me down and drag me back no matter where I go...

response.speaker: Cuchihua
response.text: I've gotta go back and apologize. But how? The road's blocked... Ugh, I'm so dead this time...

talks.objective: Clear the Pulverite blocking the path

dialogues.speaker: Masose
dialogues.text: Oh no, Itsaho, there's still so much missing from the list... H—Help me look for them, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Itsaho
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Don't waste your time. I already checked. Most of them were fragile goods. Do you really think any of them are still in one piece after the eruption and the crash?

dialogues.speaker: Itsaho
dialogues.text: Save your energy and take a break. We've got a long road ahead of us once the boss and the others get back.

dialogues.speaker: Masose
dialogues.text: N—No way! F—Fine, if you're not going, I'll just go myself...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave.

dialogues.speaker: Itzayah
dialogues.text: Phew... what a mess to deal with. To think that I almost got knocked flat by some Tepetlisaurs... That just boils my blood!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You've got it all wrong — those are Abyssal monsters! They're way more dangerous than Tepetlisaurs. So you thought they were just ordinary ones... No wonder you struggled!

dialogues.speaker: Itzayah
dialogues.text: Hah, is that it? Makes sense now. I really owe you this time. If it weren't for you guys, I'd have been done for.

dialogues.speaker: Itzayah
dialogues.text: Hold on a sec, I need to go round up those useless idiots first. I'll thank you properly once I make sure they're all safe.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With your help, the people from the caravan gradually gather around.

dialogues.speaker: Tizlo
dialogues.text: So, it's all thanks to these three that you made it out safe, boss?

dialogues.speaker: Itzayah
dialogues.text: Haha, that's right! You should've seen them in action — took down those monsters in just a couple of moves!

dialogues.speaker: Tizlo
dialogues.text: You saved the caravan leader. That's a debt I haven't much to offer in repayment for. But please, take this small gift as a token of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Itzayah
dialogues.text: Seriously, Tizlo? Have you always been this stingy? That's all you're giving to the people who saved your life!?

dialogues.speaker: Itzayah
dialogues.text: Hey, chubby! Ensuring the caravan's safety is your job, isn't it? So what's this about someone else having to clean up your mess? What do you have to say for yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Cuchihua
dialogues.text: I—

dialogues.speaker: Itzayah
dialogues.text: Quit stuttering! If you hadn't panicked and dropped your guard, a few measly monsters wouldn't have been a problem for me! This time, you're giving up part of your pay to thank our savior. Got it?

dialogues.speaker: Cuchihua
dialogues.text: I—I... I'll do whatever you say, boss...

dialogues.speaker: Itzayah
dialogues.text: Of course, such a small token as a life-saving gift does seem a bit stingy, doesn't it?

choices.text: Indeed, it feels a bit lacking.

response.speaker: Itzayah
response.text: Haha, well said! I like people like you — you say it how it is!

response.speaker: Itzayah
response.text: Ahem, anyway, this is a personal gift from me to you. Just accept it! Consider it a little something extra for your little Tepetlisaurus to get some more snacks. No need for any thanks or formalities!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Itzayah
response.text: Alright, we still need to go pick up all the stuff we lost along the way. We'll be heading off now! May we meet again!

choices.text: No, this is more than enough.

response.speaker: Itzayah
response.text: Tsk, you're really not very forthright, are you? That's no fun. Just take it already! Otherwise, if word gets out, people will label me a cheapskate.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Share Phlogiston.

dialogues.speaker: Abeni
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The injured Tatankasaurs look extremely exhausted.)

dialogues.speaker: Abeni
dialogues.text: Ugh... Ow, ow...
